query:
UPDATE channel_keys
                SET failed_count = failed_count + 1,
                    last_error = $2,
                    status = 3,
                    cooldown_until = greatest(cooldown_until, now() + make_interval(secs => $3::bigint::double precision)),
                    updated_at = now()
                WHERE id = $1 AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
